pictures.author: Mattias Hill
pictures.observed: Twin octagonal stone towers/lead spires/finials, upper arched apertures and arrow slits, recessed central opening, crenels/corbels and flanking stone walls. Modern banners and fine inscription subjects excluded.

pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Open court-facing pointed arcade on slender stone shafts, broad low lead hip roof/timber soffit, red brick rear wall with arched windows and a central entrance. Fine ceiling artwork and visitors excluded.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Gate of Salutation (Babusselam) only, first of18 explicitly required Topkapi Palace assets. Specific twin octagonal stone towers/lead spires/finials and upper arched slots/arrow slits, recessed central arch with a genuinely open smaller through-passage, crenellated parapet/corbels, red-brick courtyard elevation and broad low lead-roof canopy on slender columns/pointed arcades. Gently rising occupied paving follows the existing front/rear standard-ground controls. No composite palace, copied calligraphy/tughra/banner artwork, private texture atlas, furnished guard rooms, visitors or movable security equipment.
